thesis: One stable poem, many linked entrances and reversible authoring moves: PAGE/MAP/SETS expose typed relations; APERTURE controls load; candidates are previewed before explicit adoption; revisions remain attributable and returnable.

lightweight heuristic feedback with explicit evidence limits
aperture / visual-load control that preserves selected and AUTHOR relations first
candidate form-support counts analogous to AXIAL lawful-support counts
constraint support is admissibility only, never a literary-quality score

30-second first-use play path: source/demo → PAGE selection → intent → TRY → ADOPT/BANK → MAP/SETS/PATH → RETURN
map-law weights and APERTURE remain intact behind an ADVANCED disclosure rather than being removed

session-only local corpus file provider; corpus bytes are not uploaded, persisted or exported

boundaries: Map is a projection, not the poem.
SOUND is approximate Latin-script heuristic in 0.1.
No automatic semantic embedding is claimed.
Forms constrain; they do not score literary value.
ADOPT is explicit and recorded; LOCK blocks adoption.
Candidate support reports explicit form-envelope compatibility only; it is not a recommendation, ranking or poetry score.
PAGE is the legibility/control entrance; MAP and SETS must earn attention rather than replace reading.
First-use orientation changes disclosure/order only; the 0.2 authoring feature set remains available.
Rendered-browser smoke of the post-rebase orientation/replay changes remains pending; static JS/DOM integrity is verified.
Local corpus contents remain session-only; RETURN records only loaded/token-count metadata and adopted/banked candidate provenance.
Local corpus context is observed co-occurrence, not automatic semantic equivalence.
FIELD LAB marks remain source evidence on handoff; Poem Map does not silently promote them into AUTHOR edges, locks, candidates or revisions.

lineage.relation: 0.1 asks whether selective visualization can answer one named question without displacing the poem; 0.2 turns that discipline into a co-creative authoring surface.

verification.field_lab_verse_handoff: PENDING_CI: source + line focus boot contract

next_bounded_test.instruction: Open fresh Poem Map. FIELD NOW should populate without opening drawers. Select one term in PAGE, use one wheel action, inspect bank/TRY→ADOPT only if useful, optionally open MAP, then EXPORT→IMPORT.
next_bounded_test.compare: Poem Map 0.1 for approachability; 0.2.1 must preserve 0.2 capability without making first contact heavier than 0.1.
next_bounded_test.stop: If first-use still requires understanding forms, relation weights or provider internals, treat that as failure and reduce disclosure—not capability.

preload.persistence: source may be saved as normal poem-map state; derived corpus is session-only and not exported
preload.purpose: Use Poem Map on actual collaboration language for naming, pattern finding, compression and route-making rather than requiring poetry-for-poetry's-sake.
